key: Check times looks at the ball around each shot and works out the exact time of the top of its flight. It uses the ball positions saved while you tracked and, for shots that have none, finds the ball in the video. Penalties and free passes are logged at the referee's call, so their time is that of the shot that follows. It then lists the shots whose logged time is off, with the time they would move to; untick any you do not want to move. Nothing changes until you press Apply changes.

It then lists the shots whose logged time is off, with the time they would move to; untick any you do not want to move. Nothing changes until you press Apply changes.
